rows.label: The Hex
rows.note: unlocks Isleweaver in Duviri navigation; no workaround

conditions: The Hex also needs The Duviri Paradox, which is solo-only.

groups.activity: clear six objectives, then defeat The Fragmented
groups.meta: 16-20 Scuttler Husks per clear, guaranteed; 20-24 on Steel Path

rows.label: Scuttler Husk
rows.note: guaranteed end-of-mission reward, not a drop roll; boosters do nothing

rows.label: Entrati Obols
rows.note: Murmur kills and Entrati containers inside Isleweaver; accumulates during the husk runs

conditions: No Companions and no Gear wheel inside Isleweaver — the Gear key summons your Kaithe instead.
Check the rolled Duviri loadout before launching Steel Path; both Oraxia and The Fragmented are heavily damage-attenuated, so a bad frame/weapon roll makes SP not worth the extra husks.
bonuses: All five blueprints can also drop from Oraxia's end-of-run chest, rotation A, 7.69% each — a bonus that reduces how many husks you need to spend.
Wall-latch or go Operator void mode during Oraxia's add phase; her Death Scuttlers disable abilities and the arena floor is a damage field.

disclosures.title: reroll a bad loadout
disclosures.body: Starting one stage of The Circuit and backing out rerolls the Duviri loadout for a couple of hours — do this before a Steel Path Isleweaver run if the roll is bad.

groups.activity: exchange Scuttler Husks for all five blueprints
groups.meta: only shown in the Dormizone, not out in Duviri
conditions: Acrithis only offers the husk exchange in the Dormizone; she does not sell it out in Duviri.
The shop lists Barrel and Gauntlet 1/2 separately because the main blueprint consumes two of each.

groups.activity: forage solo, ignoring the spiral objectives, for the build materials
groups.meta: run it outside Isleweaver — Isleweaver rarely routes past these fields, and Companions are disabled there

rows.label: Kovnik
rows.note: plant across open Duviri, occasionally Teshin's Cave

rows.label: Aggristone
rows.note: breakable formations; also drops from spiral objectives and The Circuit

rows.label: Connla Sprout
rows.note: crevices near water and caves, densest near the Lunaro Court

rows.label: Rune Marrow
rows.note: Runic Compact deposits in the Undercroft and The Circuit; guaranteed off Corrupted Vor and Corrupted Jackal

rows.label: Silphsela
rows.note: Sun Silph plants on hill slopes, thickest near Titan's Rest

conditions: Take the Bountiful Harvest decree before you start; it doubles plant pickups (Kovnik, Connla Sprout, Silphsela, Saggen Pearl) and stacks with Resource Boosters.
Duviri only banks your loot when progress saves — complete one decree or Intrinsic point after collecting, then abort; doing the decree first can bank fewer than you gathered.
Ride the Kaithe: it reveals nearby resources on the minimap, which matters most for Connla Sprout.

groups.meta: 12h each; components must be claimed before the main blueprint accepts them

rows.label: Barrel ×2
rows.note: each 15,000 cr, 375 Entrati Obols, 150 Kovnik, 100 Connla Sprout, 75 Saggen Pearl

rows.label: Gauntlet ×2
rows.note: each 15,000 cr, 50 Temporal Dust, 150 Aggristone, 10 Silphsela, 75 Rune Marrow

conditions: All four components build in parallel; queue the main blueprint only after claiming them out of the foundry — minimum 24h before the final 12h.

disclosures.title: the patch-note discrepancy
disclosures.body: DE's own Update 39 patch notes say Scuttler Husk rewards are 3-5 on Normal and 5-8 on Steel Path; the wiki and live drop tables both say 16-20 and 20-24. Go by the wiki/live figures — no hotfix that changed it turned up.
